text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm baaack! I had myself an
amazing time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow... You're smiling from ear to ear,
Trainer! I'm
glad I could make ya so
happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep runnin' in all these big races and
turn
everybody into real happy campers!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Your performance at the NHK Mile Cup
was
absolutely stunning!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, thank ya very much! If it's a sprint,
you can
believe I'm takin' the number
one spot!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If you're looking to be crowned

Umamusume of the Year, you'll first have
to claim
the URA award in the sprint
division.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
However... while the NHK Mile Cup is a
G1 race,
only classic-year runners can
join.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
The selection for the top sprinter also
includes
seasoned senior-year runners.
You need to
consider your next moves
with that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, I got ya! Seniors, huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I wanna race against seniors too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll become the best sprinter there is!
And
Umamusume of the Year too, of
course!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Wait... You're not thinking of becoming
the
autumn King of the Mile by winning
the Mile
Championship, are you?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship... Now there's a
name
that gets my heart thumpin'!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
You'll be up against highly experienced
seniors. It
won't be easy to achieve the
same results you've
had up until now.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how do you intend to tackle this
hurdle?

Otonashi is making perfect sense—it will
take a
lot of preparation to compete
against the seniors
on equal footing.
So in order to build up that experience...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The Unicorn Stakes? If I do recall, that's
a—

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Um... Isn't that a dirt race?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thought so!

If we're looking to gain more practical
know-how,
this race fulfills all our needs.

Plus, Taiki Shuttle has what it takes to
run on
anything!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No problem! I'm down to give it a go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll run whichever race ya think is best,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Th-that's... simply amazing!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Despite the steep path ahead, you
continue to
press on with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
You've chosen to push her forward,
unfettered by
the threat of sand in your
eyes or muddy water in
your hair!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... The idea that you've steeled
yourself for
such dire straits is truly
awe-inspiring!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right! I won't let your sacrifice be in
vain,
Trainer!

The conversation has gotten a little out
of hand,
but regardless, we have the
Unicorn Stakes to
prepare for.
